newsHighlights.title: Steady growth trajectory driven by innovation
newsHighlights.summary: China's October economic data show a steadily improving economy with double-digit growth in high-tech manufacturing amid global uncertainties.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国10月经济数据显示经济稳步向好，高技术制造业实现两位数增长，在全球不确定性中持续推进结构升级。

newsHighlights.title: Shenzhou XXIV to launch soon with first Chinese-foreign astronaut team
newsHighlights.summary: China's Shenzhou XXIV manned mission is scheduled to launch soon, transporting three astronauts to the Tiangong space station.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国神舟二十四号载人任务即将发射，将把三名航天员送上天宫空间站。

newsHighlights.title: A link to APEC: Why are global youth choosing Hangzhou?
newsHighlights.summary: Young people from around the world are drawn to Hangzhou for its booming digital economy, AI ecosystem and open innovation environment.
newsHighlights.translation: 世界各地的年轻人被杭州蓬勃的数字经济、人工智能生态和开放的创新环境所吸引。

newsHighlights.title: Xi urges further development of Greater Bay Area
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping called for new efforts to build the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area into a hub of scientific and technological innovation.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席呼吁加大力度，将粤港澳大湾区建设成为科技创新中心。

quote.quote: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
quote.author: Alan Kay
quote.translation: 预测未来最好的方式，就是去创造它。
quote.explanation: 这句名言强调创新的力量：面对不确定性，与其被动等待，不如用科技和创造力主动塑造未来。今日新闻中高技术制造业的快速增长与航天任务的推进，正是这句话的生动体现。

vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 Chinese, Russian, US heads of state to hold landmark talks。

pattern.pattern: be scheduled to + 动词原形（计划/预定做某事）
pattern.example: The Shenzhou XXIV mission is scheduled to be launched in the near future.
pattern.translation: 神舟二十四号任务计划在不久后发射。
pattern.usage: 该句型常用于新闻报道，表示某事已被安排在特定时间进行。主语 + be scheduled to + 动词原形，也可用 It is scheduled that... 结构。例如：The new AI model is scheduled to be released next month.（这款新的人工智能模型定于下月发布。）

grammar.title: 让步介词 despite 的用法（despite + 名词/动名词）
grammar.explanation: despite 表示“尽管、虽然”，后面直接接名词、代词或动名词（doing），不能接完整的句子；若要接句子，需用 despite the fact that 或 in spite of the fact that。despite 与 in spite of 意思相同，但 despite 后不加 of。
examples: October's economic data point to a steadily improving economy despite global uncertainties.
High-tech manufacturing kept double-digit growth despite rising costs.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 /ˈdʒek/。注意第一个音节弱读为 /trə/，中间的 /dʒ/ 是浊辅音，类似“之”，结尾 /ri/ 要轻读。常见错误是把重音放在第一音节或把 /dʒ/ 发成 /j/。
examples: China's growth trajectory has been steady and strong.
The rocket's trajectory was carefully calculated before launch.

reading.title: Innovation Drives China's Steady Growth
reading.content:
China's latest economic data show a clear message: innovation is powering steady growth. In October, high-tech manufacturing recorded double-digit growth, even as global uncertainties continue to affect trade and investment. Economists say the country is undergoing structural upgrading, moving from traditional industries toward advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, robotics and the digital economy.

Space technology is another highlight. The Shenzhou XXIV mission is scheduled to launch soon, carrying three astronauts to the Tiangong space station. It will be the first Chinese-foreign astronaut team, marking a landmark step in international cooperation.

At the same time, cities like Hangzhou are attracting global youth with their booming AI ecosystems. As Alan Kay once said, the best way to predict the future is to invent it. For China, invention and innovation remain the engine of tomorrow's growth.
reading.translation:
中国最新的经济数据传递出一个清晰的信号：创新正在推动经济稳步增长。10月，高技术制造业实现两位数增长，尽管全球不确定性仍在影响贸易与投资。经济学家表示，中国正在经历结构性升级，从传统产业转向人工智能、机器人和数字经济等先进技术。

航天技术是另一大亮点。神舟二十四号任务即将发射，将把三名航天员送上天宫空间站。这将是首个中外航天员联合乘组，标志着国际合作的里程碑式一步。

与此同时，杭州等城市正以其蓬勃的人工智能生态吸引全球青年。正如艾伦·凯所说：预测未来最好的方式，就是去创造它。对中国而言，发明与创新仍是明日增长的引擎。
reading.sourceNote: 本文根据 ChinaDaily《Steady growth trajectory driven by innovation》《Shenzhou XXIV to launch soon with first Chinese-foreign astronaut team》《A link to APEC: Why are global youth choosing Hangzhou?》等 2026 年 11 月 18 日真实新闻改写，用于英语学习目的。
